title: Enhance AddItemSheet focus and last-used aisle defaults
description: Add auto-focus behavior to AddItemSheet and persist the last-picked aisle with SceneStorage so repeated item entry defaults to the prior aisle when it still exists in the current catalog.
acceptance_criteria: AddItemSheet uses FocusState so the item text field is focused when the sheet appears.
Opening AddItemSheet auto-summons keyboard focus reliably on supported sheet presentation paths.
AddItemSheet stores the last selected aisle name in SceneStorage when Add succeeds.
When a stored aisle still exists in catalog.aisles, the picker defaults to that aisle on open.
When there is no stored aisle or the stored aisle is absent from the current catalog, the sheet falls back to the existing default behavior without crashing.
The Other/default aisle path remains consistent when re-opening the sheet.
